correctness.rationale: An equality graph with v vertices and c components has q^c consistent labels. Two distinct reflection matchings have no common edge and cannot have an alternating cycle, since two reflections compose to a nonzero translation on the integer line. For three consecutive windows, compositions of consecutive reflections connect x to x+2 for every x from 0 through k−1 in the block of length k+2 (allowing a reflection to fix its center). Thus each parity is connected, and the middle matching joins the two parities exactly when k is even. The rank is 2r+1 in either case. At k=2 or 3 any selected equalities form a forest. Distinct-index third cumulants are nonnegative since the joint rank is at most 3r; all repeated-index terms reduce to those of independent Bernoulli variables. The positive consecutive-triple contribution therefore rules out a binomial count, not just mutual independence. For k=4 and 5 I independently computed binary incidence-matrix ranks for all 15 and 28 offsets, respectively, with 1≤a<b≤2k−2. Only (1,2) has rank deficit, equal to one. For b≥2k−1 one gap is ≥k and separates an outer window. Direct word enumeration at five selected (q,k,N) also confirmed the count's third cumulant. In the nonuniform boundary overlap, one size-three equality component replaces two size-two components, and the bracket equals Var(w_X) for X with law w, proving the stated rigidity. All cases M=1,2 and r=1 are consistent.
residual_risks: Finite replay verifies the k=4,5 offset step and selected count moments, not the unbounded claims; those use the reflection and cumulant arguments.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: With uniform letters on a cyclic alphabet, all adjacent sums are again i.i.d. uniform, and an odd window is palindromic iff its adjacent-sum window is palindromic. This transfers established even-length results to the next odd length but does not supply the even-length cutoff or triple law. At even k, a fixed alphabet involution on the odd positions also converts reverse-complement matching to literal reversal simultaneously for all starts under a uniform law; consequently the unavailable DNA paper is a real potential overlap, not ruled out solely by terminology. The accessible separated-repeat model did not furnish the fixed-window classification.

value.rationale: This settles when a binomial model of a basic sliding-window statistic is exact: mean and variance match for every length, yet the third cumulant detects a sharp failure. An exact correction at the first two nontrivial lengths and the uniformity criterion at one shared site make the result useful for calibrating dependence, beyond a routine moment or a few tabulated examples.
residual_risks: Not a tail approximation or a claim about non-i.i.d. sources; odd-length instances are related to the previous even length.
